newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Jinro woes forecast to further drag Seoul stocks.
newsitem.headline: Jinro woes forecast to further drag Seoul stocks.

text.p: South Korean stocks are forecast to fall on Wednesday on continued concerns over the Jinro Group's financial trouble, brokers said.
The conglomerate's flagship Jinro Ltd has failed to pay back debts but all its bank accounts remained open, the company's prime creditor bank said on Tuesday.
"Jinro's trouble will continue to hurt the overall sentiment today," said Lee Mun-chang of Coryo Securities.
The Jinro Group said last week it would sell some of its property and affiliates to raise cash to pay back debts.
The composite index fell 9.38 points to 687.96 on Tuesday.
